title: China projects itself as a "stable power" as it greets US and Russia in less than a week
summary: Russia's President Vladimir Putin is visiting his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping, less than a week after US President Donald Trump's high-profile visit. The talks are likely to be dominated by the trade relations between the two countries, with China presenting a lifeline for sanctioned Russia. FRANCE 24's Jan Camenzind Broomby tells us more from Taiwan.
